observations: body L2, L20, L24-L25: «al–Battānī» is letter-spaced, with long dashes (5.4 pt in L2 and L20); «al–Khāzinī», letter-spaced, is divided between L24 and L25, the dash after «al» 5.5 pt long and the one before «Khāzinī» 3.8 pt, like a hyphen.

body L5-L7: with the least diameter 31′ 20″ (p. 58 of the translation) and the least hourly motion 2′ 23″, the rule gives the greatest diameter of p. 58, 33′ 40″, for the hourly motion 2′ 23″ × 33′ 40″ : 31′ 20″ = 2′ 33,6″. A heavy bracket closes the addition begun on p. 281, L39; the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 10.2 pt.
body L8-L9: the head of the chapter is set in the larger type, as printed (capitals 9.7 pt high); the dash after «a)» measures 10.0 pt.

body L10-L11: the dots are five. The quotation of the translation, p. 115, l. 15-19, leaves out the Greek in brackets after «afīǵiyūn» and «ferīǵiyūn» and has «austri» for «Austri». The dash after «appellata »» (L11) measures 10.3 pt.
body L13: «412–13» has a long dash (4.4 pt).

body L14: the Arabic is printed «افيثخون هو الشمال فرنجيون هو الجنوب»: the Greek words are spelled افيثخون and فرنجيون, against afīǵiyūn and ferīǵiyūn of L10-L11; every dot was read on the enlarged scan.

body L16, L18-L19, L30: «Ptolemaei» (L16), «Gherardus Cremonensis» and «Schoneri» are letter-spaced; «Ptolemaei» in L21 is not. «Efegion–Septentrio» and «Efregion–Meridies» (L19) have long dashes (5.4 pt each), and «Efegion» is printed without r.

body L25, L27-L28: «az–zīǵ» and «as–sanǵarī» have long dashes (5.3 and 5.4 pt). The Arabic titles are printed «افرنجيون زحل وهو صاعد في الشمال» and «افحون زحل وهو هابط في الجنوب»; in the first the tooth of the ي before و prints without its dots, as a mound apart from the letters beside it, and in the second the fa prints apart from the ḥa. The print sets L27 and L28 14.2 and 14.8 pt below the lines before them, against a pitch of 13.9 pt.
body L33-L36: the f of «efregion» (L33, L34) prints with its top broken, like e/region; L36 has «effregion» twice, as L11 and «effregio» L12.

notes_left L1-L4: «Ptolemei Phelu-diensis Alexandrini» is letter-spaced; the hyphens of «Phelu-», «prin-» and «Pe-» print short and raised, like points. The rule between the two columns of the notes prints faint and broken.
notes_right L1-L2: the dash before «Fuit» measures 8.8 pt; «1114-1187» has a hyphen (3.5 pt).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
